lede: The web's attention converged hard on Patrick Stewart, whose Wikipedia page drew 1,882,386 views, nearly four times the runner-up, while Hacker News ran a 134-point Next Generation episode guessing game in his honour. Related pages moved with him: his wife Sunny Ozell and longtime co-star Ian McKellen both climbed the same list. Away from that, the 2026 Israeli legislative election surfaced on both Polymarket and Wikipedia at once, and the day's loudest technology thread was an 850-point report of a backdoor in a Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through the Cursor marketplace.

throughlines.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
throughlines.gist: The 2026 Israeli legislative election is pulling in both encyclopedia readers and prediction-market money, with Polymarket pricing whether Likud takes the most seats and whether Netanyahu stays prime minister.

throughlines.title: Apex Legends™
throughlines.gist: Respawn's Apex Legends is live on two feeds at once, holding 199,183 concurrent Steam players while its Cipher gameplay trailer pulls 701,586 views on YouTube.

throughlines.title: War Thunder
throughlines.gist: War Thunder shows the same shape, with 101,280 concurrent players on Steam and 400,220 views on its 'Eagle's Shadow' update trailer.
